name: Spironolactone
class: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist with antiandrogen activity
description: A potassium-sparing mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist approved for heart failure, hypertension, oedema and primary hyperaldosteronism. It also antagonises the androgen receptor, which is the basis of off-label dermatological and gender-affirming use.

systems.note: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonism in heart failure and hypertension; the labelled indication.
Hyperkalaemia is the characteristic labelled risk and can be fatal.
Androgen receptor antagonism and gynaecomastia are labelled off-target effects.

monitors.why: Hyperkalaemia is the characteristic labelled risk; this is the defining monitoring parameter.
Renal function governs potassium handling on this drug.
Labelled contraindication thresholds are expressed in filtration terms.
Androgen receptor antagonism is a labelled off-target effect.
